title: Nte Gymna Species
paragraphs: “It looks like it’s hard to hit a smaller target, but wouldn’t it also be difficult for Rifana to attack after shrinking?”
“I wonder about that—”
Before Father could finish speaking, the weasel that was supposedly big sister’s friend switched to the offensive.
“Here I come! Sha sha sha sha!”

Whoosh… Big sister’s friend moved at several times the speed from before and began brushing Kou’s body without using her claws. Incredible speed. I could probably manage somehow, but even for me, it’s still pretty fast.
“Whoa! There’s more than one Rifana!?”

Big sister raised her voice in surprise. I had enough levels to see how big sister’s friend was moving, but since big sister lacked the speed, it must have looked to her as if Rifana had multiplied. No, there’s a trace of magic. Big sister’s friend is also skilled in fire illusions, so she’s likely creating the illusion of multiple copies to confuse her opponent.
“W-w-what!? Rifana multiplied!”

Kou was also shocked, desperately trying to follow big sister’s friend with his eyes. With several duplicates surrounding him, all of them brushing against his body… If this were an actual attack, the situation would be dire. Kou was completely overwhelmed, unable to do anything.
“W-what’s happening… Shaaaa!”
Big sister’s friend let out a noise that sounded both like a threat and laughter.
“Ahaha! That tickles! Rifana, stop it!”
“Okay.”

Big sister’s friend suddenly stopped and struck a pose with her back turned to Kou. At that moment, all of Kou’s feathers stood on end, and with a swift whoosh, unnecessary feathers shed and scattered into the air. With a thud, Kou collapsed face down.
“I won! Victory roar! Shaaaa! Just kidding.”
It didn’t sound like a snake’s threat, but more like a cat… no, it was exactly like a weasel’s threat.
“Uh…”
“Ah! Naofumi-sama!”
The weasel, who seemed to be big sister’s friend, noticed Father and came running over. She leaped onto Father’s body and climbed up to sit on his shoulder.
“Whoa!”
Father raised his arm to keep her from falling, and big sister’s friend struck a pose on top of Father’s shield.
Was it a victory pose? Her right arm was raised diagonally, with her left arm slightly pulled back to follow.
Hmm…? This feels like something I’ve seen before.
“Did you see? What do you think?”

Big sister’s friend danced on top of Father’s shield, extending both hands forward and spinning as she struck another pose. Father, perhaps unconsciously, gently stroked her throat with his index finger.
“Iwatani, I’m so jealous! You get to carry Rifana!”
Kou looked at Father with envy.
“Luna’s jealous too! Small and cute like Keel-kun!”
At some point, Luna had come over, carrying Keel in her arms.
“Rifana’s smaller than me! How strong is she now!?”
“I can move even faster than before!”
“That’s amazing!”
Big sister’s friend answered proudly.
What exactly is happening here?
“Ah… I think I heard something about the representative of Schildfrieden having that kind of ability. Maybe Rifana has a similar latent talent?”

Come to think of it… I recall Father saying something about analyzing Fohl back when he set out to conquer the world and mentioning that he had some hidden potential. It seems a similar potential has blossomed here.
“I’ll keep doing my best from now on!”
“Yeah. Keep it up.”
“Yes!”
Big sister’s friend was brimming with enthusiasm. Sakura and Rival were looking enviously at her as she struck a joyful pose atop Father’s shield.
“Naofumi’s attention is supposed to be on Gaelion! But Gaelion has to appeal as a mature woman, so I’ll hold back for now.”
“Sakura wants to shrink and dance with Rifana on Naofumi’s shield too!”
“Wanna do it?”
Big sister’s friend beckoned Sakura as if to say, “Come on.”
“Hmm! If Sakura’s doing it, Gaelion won’t hold back either! But… shrinking this much is hard for Gaelion…”
“You don’t have to compete, okay?”
Father looked troubled as he tried to stop big sister’s friend, Sakura, and Rival.
Exactly! Sakura is fine, but Rival, you’re not!
“You’re being noisy.”

Just then, the doctor arrived. She had taken on the task of modifying the bioplant and had been bringing monsters from her own research lab to the village to take care of things. Thanks to the doctor, the village was gradually beginning to resemble the original world.
“Huh… So the Nte Gymna species can undergo a transformation similar to the Hakuko and Aotatsu species, which are known to have a second transformation.”
“Nte Gymna species? Is that Rifana’s race?”

“Yes. A few days ago, when I was helping with the Soul Vacuum research, I heard about it. Apparently, there are some demi-human species that can retain their consciousness even after death. Those are the Nte species. And the ones that can transform into beasts are the Nte Gymna species.”

Hmm? Did we have that conversation? Ah, now that I think about it, it was when I explained the methods we used to take down reincarnators, teleporters, and possessors based on Rival’s testimony. Father must have been talking to the doctor about it back then. By the way, Rival seems to remember those details quite well and apparently witnessed what the previous doctor was researching.
“Well, this isn’t exactly my area of expertise, but I’ve heard that in the region where this originated, it’s associated with dark magic and used as sacrifices in rituals.”
“I see… So that’s the kind of race Rifana belongs to.”
“No matter what happens, I am me! I’ll become even stronger and be of greater use to Naofumi-sama!”

Big sister’s friend wagged her tail, clearly excited. I understand that excitement of awakening to greater power myself. It’s a feeling of anticipation that’s rare and hard to experience, so I can’t blame her.
